supersession_scope: sandbox routing only; reviewer prompt, model, input commit, tree, and role are unchanged

codex_bypass_scope: approval and inner-sandbox routing only; all agent subprocesses inherit the outer OS profile
hooks_and_mcp: not loaded through ignored user config
delegation: forbidden; one bound Reviewer identity only
allowed_inputs: reviewer Git metadata required for commit/tree/clean-state verification
eligible licensed-public auxiliary corpus only if already present beneath the allowed paths
os_denied_reads: main Guildhall repository and prior review evidence
os_denied_writes: run-control directory from inside the reviewer process
write_authority: none on every run and repository surface
authorized_execution: read-only static inspection, collection, and product-independent detector self-tests
same_user_confidentiality_claim: not claimed beyond the enforced path-denial profile and audited tool trace
